notes: REF-BM-04: edit form/PATCH allow title/description/note/labels only; URL cannot be edited. REF-BM-24: no snapshot feature; no HTML/PDF storage. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-29: no saved bundles/filters. REF-BM-30: no Netscape HTML import. REF-BM-31: no export.
